name: Spec to tickets
description: Weekday mornings: slice at most one newly merged spec into tickets, each carrying its Agent Brief in the body. A ticket with no open blocker is ready at once, and "Implement the next ready issue" takes it; the rest become ready as their blockers close (ADR 0008).

task.prompt: Run the afk-to-tickets skill for {{project}} on {{date}}: slice at most one unsliced spec.
